tools.name: get_availability
tools.description:
Check whether a WEE WiLDS unit is available for a date range.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
              The "bb" slug returns per-room availability across all 4 B&B rooms.
        check_in: Arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must not be in the past.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description:
Get the price range for a WEE WiLDS unit.

    Returns a static min/max GBP range. Dynamic per-night quotes are not yet
    available — for an exact quote, use send_inquiry.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description:
Email a booking inquiry to hello@weewilds.com on behalf of a guest.

    Requires an access token (Authorization: Bearer header). Without one this
    tool sends nothing and returns the direct booking URL instead — send the
    guest there, or to hello@weewilds.com.

    Does NOT create an OwnerRez

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "send_inquiry" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Email a booking inquiry to hello@weewilds.com on behalf of a guest. Requires an access token (Authorization: Bearer header). Without one this tool sends nothing…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_availability · Private data: send_inquiry · Public sink: get_pricing, send_inquiry · Destructive: get_availability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_availability · Private data: send_inquiry · Public sink: get_pricing, send_inquiry · Destructive: get_availability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
